picks.title: JSEI Dirt Trapper Door Mat 24" x 36", Non-Slip Washable Doormats, Blue
feature_bullets: Built for Everyday Entry Areas: Place this door mat at your entrance, front door, back door, hallway entry, laundry entry or mudroom entry. It gives wet shoes and daily foot traffic a defined landing spot before dirt spreads through the home.

Low Profile for Door Clearance: The low-profile design helps the mat sit comfortably in common doorway areas without a bulky look. Please measure your door clearance before purchase, especially if your door has a low sweep or raised threshold.

Absorbent Surface for Wet Shoes and Dirt: The textured surface helps absorb moisture and catch everyday dust, grit and dirt from shoes. It is useful for rainy days, busy family traffic and dirty paws near entry areas.

picks.title: JSEI Stair Treads 15PCs Light Grey Door Mat for Entrance 36‘’ x 60‘’ Light Grey
feature_bullets: Built for Indoor Wooden Steps: Cover your indoor wooden stairs with a 15-pack of stair treads sized 8" x 30". Each tread is made for common indoor steps and helps turn bare wood stairs into a more comfortable walking surface for daily family use.

Helps Improve Traction: The TPE non-slip backing helps the tread grip clean, dry indoor wooden stairs. For best results, install each stair mat on a flat, dust-free surface and avoid using it on wet, oily, uneven, or outdoor steps.

Comfortable for Kids, Seniors and Pets: The polyester surface gives feet and paws a softer step than bare wood. Use these stair treads in homes with kids, seniors, or dogs that need steadier footing on indoor stairs.
